title: 1664. Ways to Make a Fair Array

examples.explanation: Remove index 0: [1,6,4] -> Even sum: 1 + 4 = 5. Odd sum: 6. Not fair. Remove index 1: [2,6,4] -> Even sum: 2 + 4 = 6. Odd sum: 6. Fair. Remove index 2: [2,1,4] -> Even sum: 2 + 4 = 6. Odd sum: 1. Not fair. Remove index 3: [2,1,6] -> Even sum: 2 + 6 = 8. Odd sum: 1. Not fair. There is 1 index that you can remove to make nums fair.
You can remove any index and the remaining array is fair.
You cannot make a fair array after removing any index.
